map.使用面积和建筑面积区别？: Difference between usable area and gross floor area?
map.使用面积是你能踩到的地面净面积；建筑面积是含墙体和公摊的外包面积，通常大 15%: The usable area is the net floor area you can actually use; the gross floor area includes walls and shared portions and is usually 15%-25% larger.
map.做收纳/家具布局前，先汇总可用地面面积，判断大家具能否放下。: Before planning storage or furniture layout, total up the usable floor area first and judge whether the large pieces will fit.
map.出租按面积计价，用净使用面积对账，避免把公摊算进租金基数。: Rent is priced by area, so reconcile against the net usable area and avoid folding shared costs into the rent base.
map.各地规则不同，部分飘窗、设备平台不计或半计；以当地测绘为准，本工具只算你输入的可: Rules vary by region: some bay windows and equipment platforms are excluded or half counted; rely on the local survey, and this tool only counts the area you enter that you can actually walk on.
map.套内使用面积一般算到墙面基层（不含抹灰外扩）；本工具按你输入的净尺寸计，需明确口: The internal usable area is normally measured to the wall base (excluding the plaster overrun); this tool uses the net dimensions you enter, so the measurement convention must be clear.
map.房屋面积计算 使用指南: How to use the floor area calculator
map.装修公司按使用面积报价时，自己量各房间长宽求和，验证报价基数是否含水。: When a renovation company quotes by usable area, measure the length and width of each room yourself and add them up to check whether the quoted basis is inflated.
map.逐间输入房间长宽，自动汇总套内总面积与各房间面积占比，并可按公摊系数换算建筑面积: Enter the length and width of each room to automatically total the internal area and the share of each room, and convert to the gross floor area with the shared-area coefficient, for property purchase and renovation estimates.
map.飘窗/设备平台算吗？: Do bay windows and equipment platforms count?
map.：卧室 4×3=12，客厅 5×4=20，厨 2.5×2=5，卫 2×1.5=3:
: bedroom 4x3=12, living room 5x4=20, kitchen 2.5x2=5, bathroom 2x1.5=3
total usable area = 12+20+5+3 = 40 m2
